headline: Bitcoin Falls Below $60,000 Amid ETF Outflows and Whale Dip-Buying
summary: Bitcoin fell below $60,000 as exchange-traded fund outflows mounted, even as market whales bought the dip.
why: Cryptocurrencies represent digital assets traded globally without central bank backing, with Bitcoin serving as the largest digital token by market capitalization.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: The report explicitly states that the price of Bitcoin fell below $60,000.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The drop below $60,000 was driven by increasing outflows from exchange-traded funds, despite some accumulation by large holders.
